legislative: CMSHA s62(5)(e), MQSHA s55(5)(e) — SHMS must address psychosocial hazards. FSO developing Safe and Respectful Workplaces UoC.
note: Almost never mentioned in JDs despite increasing legislative focus. Key gap for training needs analysis.

legislative: CMSHA s30(2)(d), Schedule 3; MQSHA s27(3)(d), Schedule 2 — SSE must provide for critical controls for material unwanted events.
note: Rarely mentioned explicitly in JDs. AUSMASA currently reviewing training products for this area.

coded_cross_check.label: Risk management methodology (knowledge)
coded_cross_check.what: Closest analogue in the manual coding.

legislative: Part of SHMS requirements under both Acts. Supervisors expected to manage emergency situations on shift.
note: Supervisors are often the first responders on shift. Under-represented in JD responsibilities.

legislative: CMSHA Part 11; MQSHR s93 — Workers must be trained in relevant legislation. Supervisors must understand their statutory obligations.
terms: coal mining safety and health act
note: JDs often say 'knowledge of legislation' generically. Few specify which Acts or the depth of knowledge expected.

coded_cross_check.label: QLD CMSHA / Mine Safety Act knowledge
coded_cross_check.what: Manual-coded knowledge of the coal Act.

coded_cross_check.label: QMSHA / Quarry Act knowledge
coded_cross_check.what: Manual-coded knowledge of the minerals/quarry Act.

legislative: RIIWHS301E is a required competency for supervisors (CMSHAC/MSHAC). CMSHA, MQSHA — investigations are part of SHMS.
note: Mentioned in some JDs but often at a high level. This is a formal competency requirement.

legislative: RIIRIS301E is a required competency. Both Acts define competence as demonstrated skill and knowledge for safety.
note: JDs mention 'risk management' generally but rarely reference the formal competency unit or process.

coded_cross_check.label: Risk management methodology (knowledge)
coded_cross_check.what: Manual-coded knowledge of a formal risk-management methodology.

legislative: RIICOM301E is a required competency for supervisors under the CMSHAC/MSHAC competency frameworks.
note: Communication is widely listed as a desired skill — DP2 ('strong communicator') appears in roughly half of JDs — but it is rarely linked to the formal RIICOM301E competency unit. The gap is in formal unit-level training, not in the underlying expectation.

coded_cross_check.label: Strong communicator (disposition)
coded_cross_check.what: How many JDs name communication as a desired attribute (any wording).

legislative: Brady Review Recommendations 2 and 4. Safety Reporting Survey findings on leadership skills. CMSHAC/MSHAC name TAE40110 (Cert IV TAE) for trainers and various Frontline Management qualifications.
note: JDs widely expect leadership behaviours — D2 ('Coach, mentor, develop team capability') appears in over half of JDs — but rarely require formal leadership credentials such as a Frontline Management certificate or Cert IV TAE. The gap is in formal training/credentials, not in the leadership duty itself.

coded_cross_check.label: Coach, mentor, develop team capability (duty)
coded_cross_check.what: How many JDs name developing the team as a duty.

coded_cross_check.label: Cert IV TAE (TAE40110)
coded_cross_check.what: How many JDs name the formal training qualification.

coded_cross_check.label: Frontline Management certificate
coded_cross_check.what: How many JDs name a Frontline Management qualification.

legislative: CMSR Part 11A; MQSHR s95A, s96 — Specific regulatory duties for supervisors including checking work quality, providing time and resources.
note: Regulatory supervisor duties are rarely reflected in JD responsibilities despite being legislated.
